evidence.sourcePassage: Carnival Corporation ("old CCL") (CUSIP: 143658300) and Carnival plc ("CUK") will be converted into a single publicly traded corporate entity, to be renamed Carnival Corporation Ltd. (CUSIP: G2004J103)
evidence.rationale: Redomiciliation of the same Carnival Corporation common stock (CIK 815097 unchanged) from Panama to Bermuda on May 7, 2026; each old share represents the same number of Carnival Corporation Ltd. common shares, still NYSE: CCL (8-K of May 7, 2026 retained as CCL-8k). Carnival plc ADS holders received new shares one-for-one; that exchange concerns CUK, not this instrument. No price series are joined.
